The original failed/interrupted Run label, admission identities, charges, events and legacy artifact/promotion gates remain unchanged.

This dependent draft targets PR98's evidence branch and contains the whole independently authored UI branch. Status2 and five reader/mutation contracts are explicitly pinned. Tab-scoped bounded request storage retains the exact actor/catalog/Run body before dispatch, including unknown acknowledgements across navigation/reload; current identity, Run and generation fence late reads/writes, with finite timers and downloads. Mutations remain owner actions; resume requires the original request actor, while a current owner can pause the exact continuation. Browser collection is bounded to8MiB; larger artifacts use the existing sealed CLI.
